Context boosting reaches only so far: a keyword lifts a weak value's score
only when it sits inside the window of a few words on either side. These
lines probe that boundary with the same weak value (a bare payment-card
number) and a "card" keyword placed at different distances.

In window (keyword within the few-word span, value should be boosted and
detected):
  The card on file is 4111 1111 1111 1111 for you.

Out of window (keyword pushed well past the span by filler words, so the
value stays weak and undetected):
  The card, according to the note we filed away last quarter, was 5555 5555 5555 4444.

The first value is close enough to "card" to cross the threshold; the second
is too far, so it must survive un-redacted even though the word "card" does
appear earlier in the sentence.
